Verdict: needs_changes. Implementer summary declares `Repo: DontPanic`, `Env: dev`, `Project: (none)` correctly, and structured `target_context.commands_run` contains no forbidden command shapes.

FINDING (medium, correctness): The selector’s own scope badge stays stale after changing projects. Evidence: `dashboard/core.js:153-159` handles selector changes by calling `setSelectedProject()`, but `setSelectedProject()` only updates state/URL/storage and the active page; a jsdom probe showed state becomes `spindine` while the selector badge still reads `Scope: Fleet`. Recommendation: re-render the selector, or update its scope badge, after `setSelectedProject()` and add an integration test.

FINDING (medium, correctness): Selector options do not refresh for registry changes that only alter display labels. Evidence: `_fleetFingerprint()` at `dashboard/core.js:299-304` fingerprints only `name` and `active`, while option labels use `display_name` in `dashboard/lib/project-selector-logic.js:99-101`; a probe changing `spindine.display_name` left the visible option as `Spin & Dine`. Recommendation: include label-relevant fields in the fingerprint or re-render after every successful fleet summary refresh.
